algorithm: Tink transfer pipeline: per-category DeepSDF shape interpolation (N_itpl=10 landmarks) + ICP-based explicit contact-label mapping + iterative Adam pose refinement (contact-consistency cost + anatomical cost + SDF-based interpenetration cost), 1000 iterations per source-target pair. Benchmarks: I2L-MeshNet / HandTailor (hand mesh recovery), Hasson et al. / Tekin et al. (hand-object pose estimation), GrabNet conditional-VAE (grasp/intent/handover generation)
hand: MANO (single-hand parametric mesh model; theta in R^(16x3), beta in R^10; 21-keypoint skeleton)
success_criterion: Grasp physical plausibility judged via penetration depth, solid intersection volume, and simulation displacement, plus a 1-5 Amazon Mechanical Turk perceptual-satisfaction score
headline_metric: Grasp physical-plausibility metrics (Penetration Depth cm, Solid Intersection Volume cm^3, Simulation Displacement mean/std cm) and MTurk perceptual score (1-5), GrabNet baseline on OakInk-Shape
headline_value: GrabNet on OakInk-Shape (Table 6): Penetration Depth 0.67 cm, Solid Intersection Volume 6.60 cm^3, Sim. Disp. Mean 1.21 cm / Std 2.05 cm, Perceptual score 3.66/5
human_data: Ink base: 230K RGB-D image frames, 12 subjects, 100 real objects, captured with 4 RealSense D435 (RGB-D) + 8 OptiTrack Prime 13W (MoCap) cameras, up to 5 intents per object (use/hold/lift-up/hand-out/receive); MANO hand pose fit via multi-view 2D-keypoint reprojection. Tink synthesizes 50,000 (49K per Table 1) hand-object interactions across 1,700 additional Oak-base objects from the 1K recorded real interactions via SDF-based shape interpolation + contact transfer + pose refinement (OakInk-Shape).
paper_code_mismatch: Code repo (github.com/oakink/OakInk) is a dataset toolkit ('oikit'); a LICENSE file exists in the repo tree but its text content was not captured, so licence type is not stated in the parsed sources.
note_gaps: Table 1 states OakInk-Shape has 49K interactions while Sec 3.4 prose states 50,000 total (minor internal discrepancy). Several equations (silhouette/temporal-smoothing/geometrical-consistency hand-fitting costs, contact-consistency cost, anatomical cost, interpenetration cost) are PDF-rendered images not captured as text. OakInk is explicitly single-hand only (objects 'designed for single-hand manipulations'); its handover task pairs two different subjects' single hands, not a joint bimanual system.
